snippet.title: SnowRunner - Dragon Wagons Dual Pack
snippet.description:
The SnowRunner Dragon Wagons Dual Pack is out! 🚛🐉

Available here: https://www.focus-entmt.com/games/snowrunner#shop

Take these two new trucks for a spin: the Heavy-class Avenhorn A15 and the Heavy-Duty Padera STD-4, with unique add-ons.
